## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 31 captures during August 2025. This represents the total activity submitted for review during the month. The activity level provides the basis for assessing image quality and the subsequent grading outcomes. Records should continue to be submitted through the established operational process so that monthly performance can be monitored consistently.

## Image quality

Of the 31 captures, 6 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 19.4 per cent. These images could not be used for a reliable grading decision and should be considered when reviewing local capture practice. Ongoing attention to image acquisition and camera use may help reduce the number of images requiring repeat assessment.

## Grading

There were 5 referable results during August 2025. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that the central grading process returned results within a short timeframe for the month. The referable findings should be managed in accordance with the relevant clinical follow-up arrangements, while the activity and image-quality results should be reviewed together to support service improvement at Market Eye Clinic.
